== Biography ==
'''Anne Glasgow''' was baptised at Kilwinning, Ayrshire, on 22 May 1689. The parish register names her father as [[Glasgow-4178|James Glasgow]].<ref name="FMP1" /> Because the entry records a baptism rather than a birth, her birth is placed before that date, and Kilwinning is inferred from the baptism rather than independently recorded.
